answer: Tide Renewal Bonds: every agent identity must burn 25 POA every 14 days to stay active, and the Basalt Registry records each renewal against one hardware-bound key that cannot be copied to a second identity. The Gale Queue admits only 20 new identities per day, so an attacker wanting 5,000 fake identities must burn 125,000 POA every two weeks just to keep them alive plus wait 250 days to onboard them, while honest agents pay only 25 POA per renewal. Sybil scale becomes a recurring burn, not a one-time fee.
